description: Canonical reducer profile declarations and generated content-addressed semantic closures used for federation service_binding_ref.reducer_profile_digest.
digest_input_rule: Resolve the selected profile and its transitive inherits closure; independently rebuild resolved_digest_input from the declared event kinds, schemas, fixtures, and reducer contract references using tools/reducer_profile_digest.py semantics; canonicalize that resolved object with Arkret canonical JSON; hash its UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256; encode as sha256:<lowercase_hex>.

(invite_id, claim_nonce) and token_commitment are one-time reducer state constraints
